property_summary: For any non-empty recipient list, C.transfer must route each low-level call through a callee exposing transferFrom(address,address,uint256) so it observes from, to, and amount plus msg.sender equal to the caller; the mutant sends transfer(address,uint256), so the recorder observes no transferFrom invocation and the decoded (from,to,amount) cannot equal the arguments.
change_summary: Replace the transferFrom selector hash string with the non-existent 'transfer(address,uint256)' so the encoded call uses the wrong selector.
